text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Takarazuka Kinen. As usual, 
I went to pick up Seiun Sky, but—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...*yawn*.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nope, I slept just fine. After all, 
Sei-chan loves her afternoon naps more 
than three square meals a day.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It's just, I couldn't exactly sleep like a 
log, though.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Maybe it's nerves~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
If anything, I guess I just overthought 
how to attack and went in circles...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, must be nerves. I mean, today is—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Special Week vs. Grass Wonder! Ughhhhh, 
I'm way too excited for this!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Just seeing these two clash is thrilling 
enough, but to think Seiun Sky would get 
in the mix too!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Gwaah, this year's Takarazuka Kinen is 
totally unpredictable! How on earth is 
this going to turn out!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Waah, what a huge crowd...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It looks like everyone was really looking 
forward to today~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Of course... I have too. I was truly, 
truly... looking forward to today.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...! Me too.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Grass-chan, and also—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Because I get to run with Sei-chan, 
too...!"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...To reach the summit as the strongest of 
our generation, I cannot surrender that 
title.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Taking you all on at once suits me just 
fine. Today, in this very place—let us 
decide who stands at the pinnacle.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Because I won't give up on being the 
best in Japan either...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Well, countin' on ya~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "H-Huh? Sei-chan?"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...You don't seem to have your usual 
composure."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what's wrong. With Sei-chan... 
and King-chan, too.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Sky-san, I've been waiting for you.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...King, you were here?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Wha-!? That's way too rude, you know!?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I know you didn't mean it that way. I 
really do understand.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Building up her strength in sprints and 
riding a massive wave of momentum, it'll 
be bad news if King overtakes us.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yes, we properly formed a strategy. I've 
brought myself to absolute peak condition.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"All that's left is to execute our 
strategy as usual. Do that, and a chance 
at victory is guaranteed."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: If not, then I—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Sky-san? What are you—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Let's do our best with pride, in true 
spirit of sports-Umamusume-ship~."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ah, Sky-sa—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Geez. And here I was trying to be 
honest for once...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Well, whatever. Anyway, right now—it's 
all about the race."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"That's right. Think. Think it all the way 
through. Because that's our only... chance 
at victory."
